dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible as multiple thin, off-white crescentic margins on the greater and median coverts; contrast is moderate against grayish-brown feather centers, creating a repetitive scalloped effect rather than distinct horizontal bands.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent with sharp, narrow pale boundaries clearly visible against the dark-centered folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct, linear boundary separates the uniform dark brown plumage of the nape from the scaled pattern of the mantle.
